# Wakapi API Reference

## Guide

- [Wakapi API Reference](https://merioneeason.github.io/wakapi-api-docs/index.md): A navigable Sourcey-generated reference for the Wakapi REST API, built from the project's own OpenAPI spec.
- [Authentication](https://merioneeason.github.io/wakapi-api-docs/authentication.md): How to authenticate against the Wakapi API with an API key.
- [Sending heartbeats](https://merioneeason.github.io/wakapi-api-docs/heartbeats.md): A worked example of pushing a coding heartbeat to Wakapi.

## API Reference

- [Wakapi API](https://merioneeason.github.io/wakapi-api-docs/api.md): REST API to interact with Wakapi
- [Get badge data](https://merioneeason.github.io/wakapi-api-docs/api/operations/operation-compat-shields-v1-user-interval-filter-get.md): Retrieve total time for a given entity (e.g. a project) within a given range (e.g. one week) in a format compatible with Shields.io. Requires public data access to be allowed.
- [List of users ranked by coding activity in descending order.](https://merioneeason.github.io/wakapi-api-docs/api/operations/operation-compat-wakatime-v1-leaders-get.md): Mimics https://wakatime.com/developers#leaders
- [Retrieve the given user](https://merioneeason.github.io/wakapi-api-docs/api/operations/operation-compat-wakatime-v1-users-user-get.md): Mimics https://wakatime.com/developers#users
- [Retrieve summary for all time](https://merioneeason.github.io/wakapi-api-docs/api/operations/operation-compat-wakatime-v1-users-user-all-time-since-today-get.md): Mimics https://wakatime.com/developers#all_time_since_today
- [Get heartbeats of user for specified date](https://merioneeason.github.io/wakapi-api-docs/api/operations/operation-compat-wakatime-v1-users-user-heartbeats-get.md): GET /compat/wakatime/v1/users/{user}/heartbeats: returns v1.HeartbeatsResult.
- [Push a new heartbeat](https://merioneeason.github.io/wakapi-api-docs/api/operations/operation-compat-wakatime-v1-users-user-heartbeats-post.md): POST /compat/wakatime/v1/users/{user}/heartbeats: takes models.Heartbeat.
- [Push new heartbeats](https://merioneeason.github.io/wakapi-api-docs/api/operations/operation-compat-wakatime-v1-users-user-heartbeats-bulk-post.md): POST /compat/wakatime/v1/users/{user}/heartbeats.bulk: takes a list of models.Heartbeat.
- [Retrieve and filter the user's projects](https://merioneeason.github.io/wakapi-api-docs/api/operations/operation-compat-wakatime-v1-users-user-projects-get.md): Mimics https://wakatime.com/developers#projects
- [Retrieve a single project](https://merioneeason.github.io/wakapi-api-docs/api/operations/operation-compat-wakatime-v1-users-user-projects-id-get.md): Mimics undocumented endpoint related to https://wakatime.com/developers#projects
- [Retrieve statistics for a given user](https://merioneeason.github.io/wakapi-api-docs/api/operations/operation-compat-wakatime-v1-users-user-stats-range-get.md): Mimics https://wakatime.com/developers#stats
- [Retrieve WakaTime-compatible summaries](https://merioneeason.github.io/wakapi-api-docs/api/operations/operation-compat-wakatime-v1-users-user-summaries-get.md): Mimics https://wakatime.com/developers#summaries.
- [List of unique user agents for given user.](https://merioneeason.github.io/wakapi-api-docs/api/operations/operation-compat-wakatime-v1-users-user-user-agents-get.md): Mimics https://wakatime.com/developers#user_agents
- [Check the application's health status](https://merioneeason.github.io/wakapi-api-docs/api/operations/operation-health-get.md): GET /health.
- [Push a new heartbeat](https://merioneeason.github.io/wakapi-api-docs/api/operations/operation-heartbeat-post.md): POST /heartbeat: takes models.Heartbeat.
- [Push new heartbeats](https://merioneeason.github.io/wakapi-api-docs/api/operations/operation-heartbeats-post.md): POST /heartbeats: takes a list of models.Heartbeat.
- [Push a new diagnostics object](https://merioneeason.github.io/wakapi-api-docs/api/operations/operation-plugins-errors-post.md): POST /plugins/errors: takes models.Diagnostics.
- [Retrieve a summary](https://merioneeason.github.io/wakapi-api-docs/api/operations/operation-summary-get.md): GET /summary: returns models.Summary.
- [Push a new heartbeat](https://merioneeason.github.io/wakapi-api-docs/api/operations/operation-users-user-heartbeats-post.md): POST /users/{user}/heartbeats: takes models.Heartbeat.
- [Push new heartbeats](https://merioneeason.github.io/wakapi-api-docs/api/operations/operation-users-user-heartbeats-bulk-post.md): POST /users/{user}/heartbeats.bulk: takes a list of models.Heartbeat.
- [Retrieve summary for statusbar](https://merioneeason.github.io/wakapi-api-docs/api/operations/operation-users-user-statusbar-today-get.md): Mimics https://wakatime.com/api/v1/users/current/statusbar/today. Have no official documentation
- [Push a new heartbeat](https://merioneeason.github.io/wakapi-api-docs/api/operations/operation-v1-users-user-heartbeats-post.md): POST /v1/users/{user}/heartbeats: takes models.Heartbeat.
- [Push new heartbeats](https://merioneeason.github.io/wakapi-api-docs/api/operations/operation-v1-users-user-heartbeats-bulk-post.md): POST /v1/users/{user}/heartbeats.bulk: takes a list of models.Heartbeat.
- [models.Diagnostics](https://merioneeason.github.io/wakapi-api-docs/api/schemas/models-diagnostics-c10d82a8db.md): Fields: architecture, cli_version, id, logs, platform, plugin and stacktrace.
- [models.Heartbeat](https://merioneeason.github.io/wakapi-api-docs/api/schemas/models-heartbeat-c54ef1e7c3.md): Fields: ai_input_tokens, ai_line_changes, ai_output_tokens, ai_prompt_length, ai_session, branch and 19 more.
- [models.Summary](https://merioneeason.github.io/wakapi-api-docs/api/schemas/models-summary-2f9cbd6874.md): Fields: branches, categories, editors, entities, from, labels and 6 more.
- [models.SummaryItem](https://merioneeason.github.io/wakapi-api-docs/api/schemas/models-summaryitem-dc743fb3ae.md): Fields: key and total.
- [v1.AllTimeData](https://merioneeason.github.io/wakapi-api-docs/api/schemas/v1-alltimedata-21c31f6b58.md): Fields: is_up_to_date, range, text and total_seconds.
- [v1.AllTimeRange](https://merioneeason.github.io/wakapi-api-docs/api/schemas/v1-alltimerange-f9eae541e7.md): Fields: end, end_date, start, start_date and timezone.
- [v1.AllTimeViewModel](https://merioneeason.github.io/wakapi-api-docs/api/schemas/v1-alltimeviewmodel-1a081651e3.md): Field: data.
- [v1.BadgeData](https://merioneeason.github.io/wakapi-api-docs/api/schemas/v1-badgedata-47ade4169f.md): Fields: color, label, message and schemaVersion.
- [v1.HeartbeatEntry](https://merioneeason.github.io/wakapi-api-docs/api/schemas/v1-heartbeatentry-098b939fbd.md): Fields: ai_input_tokens, ai_line_changes, ai_output_tokens, ai_prompt_length, ai_session, branch and 18 more.
- [v1.HeartbeatsResult](https://merioneeason.github.io/wakapi-api-docs/api/schemas/v1-heartbeatsresult-a519901c6e.md): Fields: data, end, start and timezone.
- [v1.LeadersCurrentUser](https://merioneeason.github.io/wakapi-api-docs/api/schemas/v1-leaderscurrentuser-8b16ecc1ab.md): Fields: page, rank and user.
- [v1.LeadersEntry](https://merioneeason.github.io/wakapi-api-docs/api/schemas/v1-leadersentry-d56388d7b8.md): Fields: rank, running_total and user.
- [v1.LeadersLanguage](https://merioneeason.github.io/wakapi-api-docs/api/schemas/v1-leaderslanguage-e6fc78a4e3.md): Fields: name and total_seconds.
- [v1.LeadersRange](https://merioneeason.github.io/wakapi-api-docs/api/schemas/v1-leadersrange-ec17d9cfce.md): Fields: end_date, end_text, name, start_date, start_text and text.
- [v1.LeadersRunningTotal](https://merioneeason.github.io/wakapi-api-docs/api/schemas/v1-leadersrunningtotal-518252c847.md): Fields: daily_average, human_readable_daily_average, human_readable_total, languages and total_seconds.
- [v1.LeadersViewModel](https://merioneeason.github.io/wakapi-api-docs/api/schemas/v1-leadersviewmodel-f47fef1205.md): Fields: current_user, data, language, page, range and total_pages.
- [v1.Project](https://merioneeason.github.io/wakapi-api-docs/api/schemas/v1-project-f03d608c26.md): Fields: created_at, human_readable_last_heartbeat_at, id, last_heartbeat_at, name and urlencoded_name.
- [v1.ProjectViewModel](https://merioneeason.github.io/wakapi-api-docs/api/schemas/v1-projectviewmodel-8ea550aca8.md): Field: data.
- [v1.ProjectsViewModel](https://merioneeason.github.io/wakapi-api-docs/api/schemas/v1-projectsviewmodel-6e85219321.md): Field: data.
- [v1.StatsData](https://merioneeason.github.io/wakapi-api-docs/api/schemas/v1-statsdata-13d21281ba.md): Fields: branches, categories, daily_average, days_including_holidays, editors, end and 16 more.
- [v1.StatsViewModel](https://merioneeason.github.io/wakapi-api-docs/api/schemas/v1-statsviewmodel-75c04f9e1c.md): Field: data.
- [v1.StatusBarViewModel](https://merioneeason.github.io/wakapi-api-docs/api/schemas/v1-statusbarviewmodel-50b8536152.md): Fields: cached_at and data.
- [v1.SummariesCumulativeTotal](https://merioneeason.github.io/wakapi-api-docs/api/schemas/v1-summariescumulativetotal-b01a3ace0a.md): Fields: decimal, digital, seconds and text.
- [v1.SummariesDailyAverage](https://merioneeason.github.io/wakapi-api-docs/api/schemas/v1-summariesdailyaverage-311c81335c.md): Fields: days_including_holidays, days_minus_holidays, holidays, seconds, seconds_including_other_language, text and text_including_other_language.
- [v1.SummariesData](https://merioneeason.github.io/wakapi-api-docs/api/schemas/v1-summariesdata-56360af692.md): Fields: branches, categories, dependencies, editors, entities, grand_total and 5 more.
- [v1.SummariesEntry](https://merioneeason.github.io/wakapi-api-docs/api/schemas/v1-summariesentry-f3bd317fd7.md): Fields: digital, hours, minutes, name, percent, seconds and 2 more.
- [v1.SummariesGrandTotal](https://merioneeason.github.io/wakapi-api-docs/api/schemas/v1-summariesgrandtotal-4bb8010130.md): Fields: digital, hours, minutes, text and total_seconds.
- [v1.SummariesRange](https://merioneeason.github.io/wakapi-api-docs/api/schemas/v1-summariesrange-b81ba9eb5e.md): Fields: date, end, start, text and timezone.
- [v1.SummariesViewModel](https://merioneeason.github.io/wakapi-api-docs/api/schemas/v1-summariesviewmodel-a34e1ba44f.md): Fields: cumulative_total, daily_average, data, end and start.
- [v1.User](https://merioneeason.github.io/wakapi-api-docs/api/schemas/v1-user-d38c47dfa9.md): Fields: created_at, display_name, email, full_name, id, is_email_confirmed and 9 more.
- [v1.UserAgentEntry](https://merioneeason.github.io/wakapi-api-docs/api/schemas/v1-useragententry-0cb80eb31e.md): Fields: editor, first_seen, id, is_browser_extension, is_desktop_app, last_seen and 3 more.
- [v1.UserAgentsViewModel](https://merioneeason.github.io/wakapi-api-docs/api/schemas/v1-useragentsviewmodel-d67192c07f.md): Fields: data and total_pages.
- [v1.UserViewModel](https://merioneeason.github.io/wakapi-api-docs/api/schemas/v1-userviewmodel-259ed4bd55.md): Field: data.
